data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims reserves at 1 January 2019 were GBP 93.9566m. Based on the claims development table, there was no material aggregate movement on prior underwriting years (net prior year development calculated as approximately nil), resulting in an effectively flat prior year development outcome. No explicit gross prior-year reserve strengthening or release is quantified elsewhere in the notes; adjustments to prior years are reflected in the income statement when made. The Syndicate continues to monitor catastrophe exposure (several Lloyd's prescribed RDS events are modelled) and notes prior adverse loss experience in certain US Property lines (2017-2018) and market losses in Marine that have influenced underwriting strategy.
raw_causal_phrases: Adjustments to the amounts of the claims provisions established in prior years are reflected in income statement for the period in which the adjustments are made.

While the Directors consider that the estimate of claims outstanding is fairly calculated on the basis of the information currently available to them, there is inherent uncertainty in relation to the ultimate liability which will vary as a result of subsequent information and events.
the Syndicate scaled back across many of the Marine classes, a segment significantly affected by market losses and unfavourable pricing conditions.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior year development movement was provided in a 'movement in prior year's provision' note. Prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development table (claims development triangle) and found to be effectively nil for older underwriting years (<=2017). Exact textual quantification of prior year gross movement is not present; the only explicit sentence refers generically to adjustments to prior year provisions being reflected in the income statement. Some narrative references are to net or qualitative impacts (e.g. adverse loss experience in 2017/2018) rather than quantified gross reserve movements.
